title: Issue 59：极权主义与政治之恶 — 一套体制如何建立、由谁执行、靠谁维持
title_en: Issue 59: Totalitarianism & Political Evil — how it is built, who executes it, who keeps it standing

questions.question: 阿伦特用「平庸之恶」描述艾希曼，她的本意最接近哪一种？
options: 后果可以极其巨大，执行者身上却找不到相称的深度；问题在不思考而非愚蠢
恶其实很小很普通，体系中的大多数参与者因此都可以被理解，他们的责任也应当被免除
真正的恶只来自少数狂热信徒，普通官僚只是被骗的旁观者
艾希曼智力低下、办事无能，只是被上级随意摆布的工具
questions.explanation: 「平庸之恶」常被误读成「恶其实很小」，她的意思正相反：后果是天文数字级的，做出它的人却很空洞。她特意说明不思考不等于愚蠢——艾希曼办事很能干，只是从不与自己对话。她也坚持解释一个人如何变成这样，不等于免除他。
questions.question_en: When Arendt described Eichmann through the "banality of evil," what did she most nearly mean?
options_en: The consequences can be immense while the perpetrator shows no matching depth; the problem is thoughtlessness, not stupidity
Evil is actually small and ordinary, so most participants in the system can be understood and their responsibility excused
Real evil comes only from a few fanatics, while ordinary bureaucrats are deceived bystanders
Eichmann was unintelligent and incompetent, a tool his superiors moved around at will
questions.explanation_en: The phrase is often misread as "evil is minor," but she meant the opposite: the consequences were astronomical while the man who carried them out was hollow. She stressed that thoughtlessness isn't stupidity—Eichmann was a capable administrator who never held an inner dialogue with himself. And she insisted that explaining how someone became this way doesn't excuse him.

questions.question: 米沃什笔下的「Ketman」——外部彻底顺从、内心保留全部异议——最终的危险在哪里？
options: 它只适用于少数知识分子，普通人没有能力长期维持
伪装带来智力上的优越感让人停不下来，而演久了会长进角色里，分不清真我
伪装迟早会被当局识破，并招来比公开反对还要严厉得多的惩罚，因此注定无法长久维持
内心的异议会不断积累，最终必然爆发为公开的反抗
questions.explanation: Ketman 有真实回报：每一次熟练的口是心非都像一次小胜，让人觉得自己没投降、只是在表演。米沃什最狠的判断是，它不是保存自我的技术，而是消耗自我的过程——演久了就分不清哪个是真的自己。这份「我很清醒」的感觉本身就是麻药。
questions.question_en: In Miłosz's account of "Ketman"—total outward conformity while privately keeping every disagreement—where does the ultimate danger lie?
options_en: It only works for a few intellectuals; ordinary people can't sustain it for long
The pretense gives a sense of intellectual superiority that keeps people going, and after long enough they grow into the role and can't tell which self is real
The authorities eventually see through the pretense and punish it far more harshly than open dissent, so it can't last
The private dissent builds up and inevitably erupts into open rebellion
questions.explanation_en: Ketman pays real rewards: each skillful act of doublespeak feels like a small victory, a sign you haven't surrendered but are only performing. Miłosz's sharpest point is that it isn't a technique for preserving the self but a process that consumes it—play the role long enough and you can't tell which self is real. The feeling of lucidity is itself the anesthetic.

questions.question: 哈维尔笔下的蔬菜店老板在橱窗里贴上「全世界无产者，联合起来！」。按《无权者的权力》的分析，这张标语真正的功能是什么？
options: 表明他真诚信仰这套意识形态，愿意为之奉献
作为一种消极抵抗，用夸张得近乎滑稽的官方口号，在众目睽睽之下暗中讽刺当局
向周围的邻居施压，迫使他们也表现出同样的忠诚
传达「我服从，请放过我」，并给服从披上无私的外衣，好对自己隐瞒
questions.explanation: 老板并不关心无产者，标语的真实讯息是「我服从，所以请放过我」；如果让他贴「我害怕，所以无条件服从」，他会感到羞耻。标语替服从提供体面的说法。也正因为体制靠这种日常配合维持，冲突的界线穿过每一个人，摘下标语这样最小的拒绝才有不成比例的分量。
questions.question_en: Havel's greengrocer puts a "Workers of the world, unite!" sign in his shop window. According to The Power of the Powerless, what is the sign's real function?
options_en: It shows he sincerely believes in the ideology and is willing to devote himself to it
A form of passive resistance, quietly mocking the authorities in plain sight with an almost comically overblown slogan
It pressures his neighbors into displaying the same loyalty
It says "I obey, so leave me alone," while dressing that obedience in a selfless-looking cover so he can hide from himself what he's doing
questions.explanation_en: The grocer doesn't care about the workers; the sign's real message is "I obey, so leave me in peace." Asked to display "I am afraid and therefore unquestioningly obedient," he'd be ashamed. The slogan supplies a dignified cover for compliance. Because the system rests on such everyday cooperation, the line of conflict runs through each person, and even taking the sign down carries outsized weight.
